s: Din me perot im machmitzin ubo k"b seipim: en niqra chametz bilshon hattora ella issa shennillosha bemayim venitchammetza al yede seor, o shehinnichuha belo eseq ad shennitchammetza meeleha, o apillu nitchammetza al yede dabar acher sheenah minah, kegon al yede shimre yayin shennityabbeshu hashshemarim battannur — hare zeh chametz gamur, vechayyabin alayv karet, shenneemar "ki kol okel machmetzet venikreta vego'", velo neemar "ki kol okel chametz" [ella] lerabbot nitchammetza mechamat dabar acher. Abal issa shennillosha beme perot apillu shahata kol hayyom belo eseq ad shennitpecha — en zeh chametz umuttar leoklah bepesach, abal eno yotze bah yede chobato, ben ballayla harishon ben belel yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, mippene shehi matztza ashira vehattora omra "lechem oni", veod sheen yotzein ella bematztza shehayeta yekola labo lide chimmutz im lo haya meshammerah mechimmutz, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"g:

Vekol hammashqin shebbaolam sheenan mittoledot hammayim sheyyitbaer besiman ts"v hem niqraim me perot, kegon hayyayin veshimre hayyayin vehashshemen ume tutim verimmonim ushear kol happerot. Vaapillu mashqin sheenam baim mipperot, kegon hechalab vehaddebash ume betzim vekayyotze bahem, hem biklal me perot leinyan zeh. Vaapillu mashqim chamutzim, kegon me tappuchim chamutzim vekayyotze bahem, im lash bahen issa ap al pi shennitchammetza mehem — mutteret, sheen zeh chametz sheosra tora:

Vekol zeh keshello nitareb bahem shum mayim baolam, abal me perot shennitareb bahem mayim apillu kol shehu — hare ellu machmitzim al yede hammayim shebbahem chimmutz gamur shechayyabim alayv karet. Velo od, ella shehem memaharim lehachmitz haissa yoter mimmayim lebaddam, shehammayim lebaddam en machmitzin et haissa shennillosha bahem ella im ken shahata shiur mil belo eseq, abal issa shennillosha beme perot im mayim memaheret lehachmitz ap im lo shahata shiur mil belo eseq. Lepikak aseru chakamim lalush bahem issa lepesach, sheqqasheh leshomrah mechimmutz. Veim abar velash bahem — tzarik leepotah miyyad (achar gemar hallisha vehaarika), sheap sheissa hannillosha bemayim lebad yakol lehashhotah kol hayyom sheenah baa lide chimmutz al yede ken im oseq bah eseq gamur, abal issa zo shemmemaheret lehachmitz — eno rashshay lehashhotah kelal (achar gemar hallisha, ella yaarikenna) veyopenna miyyad. Veim abar velo apa miyyad, ap al pi sheasaq bah eseq gamur — asura baakila, abal mutteret bahanaa o lehashhotah ad leachar happesach kol shello shahata shiur mil belo eseq:

En chilluq ben im lash issa beme perot shennitarebu bahem mayim qodem hallisha o bishat hallisha, uben im haissa nillosha beme perot bilbad veachar kak nitarebu bahem mayim qodem haapiyya, o shennillosha bemayim lebad veachar kak nitarebu bah me perot qodem haapiyya. Lepikak, en mebashshelin issat matztzot apillu beme perot, sheyyesh lachosh shemma temaher lehachmitz qodem shettitbashshel, kevan shehi nillosha bemayim. (Abal muttar liqtop hammatztzot beme perot qodem haapiyya ap al pi shennillosha bemayim, lepi shehaqqittup hu dabar muat veenah memaheret lehachmitz al yede ken. Umittaam zeh yesh lehattir im napelu meat me perot letok haissa shennillosha bemayim velo apaah miyyad):

Ap al pi shemme perot shennitarebu bahem mayim en lashin bahem — ap al pi ken muttar lalush beyayin. Ap shei epshar shello nitorba bo tippa mayim bishat habbatzir, vegam lekattechilla regilin leareb bo mayim bishat habbatzir mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qk"v — en chosheshin lammayim hallalu, dekevan shennitarebu bo beodo tirosh shello haya adayin yayin, vekol shehu toses hu nitbattel venaaseh yayin, im ken gam hammayim shennitarebu bo hupag taman venishtannu lihyot yayin kederek shennishtanna hattirosh venehpak leyayin. Abal beodo tirosh asur lalush bo:

Issa shennillosha bemayim im me perot, ap al pi shehi yekola labo lide chimmutz — en yotzein bah yede choba im shemarah mechimmutz vaapaah miyyad, mippene shehi matztza ashira. Vaapillu im nillosha bemayim rabbim umeat me perot, ap al pi ken kevan sheyyesh bah taam me perot — hare hi niqret matztza ashira. Abal im en bah taam me perot, dehaynu sheyyesh bah shishshim keneged hamme perot sheereb bah — muttar latzet bah yede chobato im apaah miyyad. Abal asur latzet yede chobato bematztzot haqqetupot beme perot ap al pi sheyyesh bahen shishshim keneged haqqittup sheal gabbehen, dekevan shehaqqittup eno meorab betok hammatztza — eno mitbattel bah, vehi niqret matztza ashira:

Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal kebar nahagu bimdinot ellu lehachamir shello lalush apillu beme perot bilbad, lepi shechosheshin shemma nitareb bahem mayim kol shehu. Veim abar velash, apillu apaah miyyad — en okelin otah bepesach, shechosheshin im nattir lo leoklah shemma paam acheret lo yopeh miyyad, lepi shello yaaleh al dato lachosh shemma nitareb bahem meat mayim. Veen leshannot hamminhag, im lo lecholeh o lezaqen hatztzerikim lekak, ki yesh mi sheomer shemmeiqqar haddin me perot hen machmitzin, velo od ella shehen memaharin lehachmitz yoter mimmayim, veissa shennillosha bahen dinah kedin issa shennillosha beme perot im mayim lepi sebara harishona, ella sheen chimmutzan chametz gamur ella chametz nuqsheh, veissuro middibre soperim:

Vaapillu leqattep hammatztzot en nohagin raq leachar apiyyatan beodan chammin. Veyesh nohagin shello leqattep bishne yamim harishonim apillu leachar apiyyatan, gezera shemma yiqqach otah lematztzot mitzva vehen pesulot, lepi shehammatztza sheadam yotze bah yede chobato tzarik shello yihyeh bah taarobet shum taam acher ella taam matztza bilbad, sheim yesh bah taarobet taam acher, oto taam hu mepig et taam hammatztza, ayyen siman ts"a seip y"b:

Chitta shennimtzet beme perot shello nitareb bahem shum mayim baolam, ap al pi shennitrakkeka hachitta — en lachosh bah shemma hechmitza, shehare me perot en machmitzin, lepikak im nitbashshela hachitta im hamme perot betok happesach venotna bahem taam — enah osartan. Vaapillu im hachitta hi mebuqqaat vehabbiqqua hu siman chimmutz, ap al pi ken anu tolin shemmechamat shennishret harbeh betok hamme perot nitpecha venitbaqqea, shehare ap issa shennillosha beme perot bilbad hi nitpachat umitchammetzet keshehi shoha harbeh ella sheen zeh chametz sheosra tora. Velo ameru shehabbiqqua hu siman chimmutz gamur ella bechitta shennimtzet bemayim, o beme perot shennitareb bahem mayim, o apillu chitta neguba vibesha shennimtzet bequa, beyadua shehayeta kebar bammayim venitbaqqea sham, shemmin hassetam kol biqqua hu mechamat mayim, abal keshennimtzet beme perot tolin shennitbaqqea leachar shennopla letokam, veen chosheshin shemma kebar hayeta bequa qodem shennopla letokam, sheen machaziqin issur missapeq:

Apillu leminhagenu sheanu chosheshin bekol me perot shemma nitareb bahem mayim, ap al pi ken en lehachamir bechitta hannimtzet betokam, ki chashasha zo enah keday ella leesor lekattechilla shello lalush bahem issa veshello laasot mehem tabshil im qemach, abal bediabad lo haya keday leesor bishbil chashasha zo. Veen anu machamirin ap bediabad ella kede shello yaaseh ken paam acheret lekattechilla im nattirem lo leoklam bepesach, abal bedabar hannaaseh meelayv, kegon chitta shennopla letok me perot — en lehachamir bediabad:

Yen tzimmuqim dino keme perot leinyan chametz, ki hammayim sheshsharu bahen hatztzimmuqim nishtannu mibberiyyatan leachar shennatenu bahen hatztzimmuqin taam yayin venithappeku lihyot hen atzman yayin, ulekak muttar lomar alehen qiddush hayyom, kemo shennitbaer besiman ar"b:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Betzimmuqim shehem anabim shelemim, ella shennikmeshu vaadayin kol kocham bahem, kevan shello nidreku meolam, lepikak kocham chazaq lehappek et hammayim shennishru bahem lihyot kemo yayin mammash. Abal anabim shennidreku veneetzru baggat al yede qora veachar kak natan mayim al hachartzannim, apillu im hu beinyan shemmuttar leqaddesh alehen, ap al pi ken lo nithappeku lihyot yayin mammash, ella hare hen keyayin mazug bemayim, shehare en meqaddeshin alehen ella im ken natan alehem shalosh middot mayim veachar kak matza arba, sheharebiit hi yayin sheyyatza min hachartzannin letok hammayim, vahare zeh kederek mezigat hayyayin sheen shotin oto keshehu chay, ella mozegin oto g' chalaqim mayim veechad yayin, veen koach hayyayin velo koach hachartzannim chazaq kol kak lehappek et hammayim lihyot kemo yayin mammash, vahare dinam keyayin meorab bemayim leinyan chametz:

Ushear kol happerot chutz min haanabim, apillu beodan shelemim shello nischat mehem kelum — en kocham chazaq lehappek et hammayim shennishru bahem lihyot dinam keme perot bilbad, ella dinam keme perot im mayim im nischat letokam mohal mehapperot. Veken mashqeh heasuy middebash (sheqqorin ma"d) dino keme perot im mayim, kevan sheiqqaro mayim:

Abal debash sheosin mitztzimmuqin sheshshorin otan bemayim techilla veachar kak sochatin otam veyotze mehem dubsham im hammayim shennibleu bahem veachar kak mebashshelim et hammayim hannischatin mehem ad shennaaseh debash — hare dino keme perot bilbad, lepi shehammayim shebbo nishtannu mibberiyyatan al yede haur lihyot debash:

Shumman mehuttak dino keme perot bilbad, apillu im miyyad leachar shehedichuhu lehakshiro middamo beodo melu[che]la[ch] bammayim samuhu biqdera lehattiko venimtza sheyyesh bo taarobet mayim — ap al pi ken en lachosh, lepi shekkeshennitbashshel shumman baqqedera [o] bailpas bishshul yapeh nisrepu hammayim babbishshul vehaleku lahem legamre. Umikkol maqom, im nimtzet chitta bashshumman kesheodennu bailpas shehittikuhu bo, ben sheadayin hu lach vetzalul, ben shekkebar qarush sham betok hailpas, im hittikuhu betok happesach — yesh leosro, sheyyesh lachosh shemma nopla hachitta letoko bailpas kesheadayin lo nitbashshel bishshul yapeh beod shehayu bo tzichtzuche mayim mehammayim shehudach bahem, veaz nitchammetza hachitta bimhera qodem shennitbashshela sham, veneesar kol hashshumman shebbailpas, shechametz bepesach bemashshehu:

Abal im horiqu hashshumman mehailpas likli acher ubeoto keli nimtzet chitta betok hashshumman, apillu horiquhu letoko keshehaya roteach, vaapillu im adayin hu roteach veniplat letoko taam hachitta — hare zeh muttar, lepi sheanu omerim: kan nimtza — kan haya, dehaynu chitta zo shennimtzet akshav bikli zeh — kebar hayeta betoko qodem shessamu hashshumman letoko, velo hayeta meolam im hashshumman betok hailpas kesheadayin haya bo tzichtzuche mayim, velo nitchammetza chitta zo meolam, veakshav enah baa lide chimmutz al yede hashshumman, kevan shekkebar haleku mimmennu tzichtzuche mayim legamre keshennitbashshel bishshul yapeh bailpas:

Vekol zeh keshello nitnaggeb hashshumman mimme hahadacha qodem shessamuhu bailpas, abal im nitnaggeb legamre mimme hahadacha veachar kak samuhu bailpas venimtzet sham chitta, apillu nimtzet qodem shennitbashshel bishshul yapeh — hare zeh muttar, sheen kan ella me perot bilbad, veen hachitta baa lide chimmutz. Vaapillu im nishra kamma yamim bammayim ad shennibleu betoko, veap sheachar kak nitnaggeb millachluchit mayim shealayv qodem shehittikuhu, mikkol maqom hammayim shehayu beluim betoko nitarebu bo keshehuttak, ap al pi ken dino keme perot bilbad belo mayim, lepi shehammayim habbeluim en shem mayim alehem kelal ad sheyyitgallu veyetzeu lachutz, kegon basar yabesh shemmazzia bimot haggeshamim mechamat hammayim shehudach bahem, ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"v ayyen sham. Abal hammatztza sheshshorin otah bemayim leachar apiyyatah vesochatin otah veachar kak lashin otah beshumman, im nopla chitta letokah — yesh lehachamir uleosrah, lepi shei epshar lesochotah kol kak, venishara betokah mayim beayin:

Lachluchit hayyotze mehammelach dino keme perot, shehammelach eno mittoledot hammayim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemelach shechoperin mehaqqarqa, abal melach shellanu shemmebashshelin otah mimmayim dino kemayim. Veyesh omerim sheddino keme perot. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona, veap al pi ken yesh lachosh gam lassebara haacharona, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"h:

Kol adam yesh lo libdoq hattablin vehammelach qodem sheyyitten mehem laqqedera bepesach, shemma yesh chitta betokam vetitchammetz betok haqqedera. Veim keshebbadaq hattablin matza bahem chitta, apillu hi meluchlechet venitrakkeka venitbaqqea — sorepah, im hu mishshaa shishshit vaelak, vehattablin muttarin apillu hu tok happesach, dekevan shehem yebeshim lo nibla bahem kelum min hachitta apillu shahata betokah kamma yamim:

Abal im matza chitta bammelach — yesh lachosh bah shemma niknas bah lachluchit hammelach meat meat ad shehechmitza, veachar kak niplat mimmenna lachluchit letok hammelach, shekken derek hammelach libloa mimmaakal hammunnach etzlo. Lepikak, tzarik littol ulehasir mehammelach meqom maggaah shel hachitta, dehaynu kerochab gudal sabib lah, vehashshear muttar im hu qodem happesach, veeno chozer veneor bepesach. Abal im haya betok happesach — tob lehachamir lekattechilla lehashhot kol hammelach ad leachar happesach. Apillu matza chitta achat bechabit melea melach — en lehistappeq mimmenna bepesach lekattechilla. Lepikak, yizzaher adam libdoq qodem happesach kol hammelach hatztzarik lo lekol yeme happesach, shebbetok happesach, dehaynu millel t"v vaelak, im yimtza bo chitta achat — yapsid et kullo:

Ubediabad, shennetano letok haqqedera mimmelach zeh shennimtza bah chitta bepesach — en leesor hammaakal shebbaqqedera, shehare en sham shamnunit velo roteb sheyyolik taam hechametz bekol hammelach. Abal im natal melach mimmeqom maggaah shel hachitta venatan letok haqqedera — yesh leesor ap bediabad:

Vekol zeh keshennitlachlecha hachitta, dehaynu shennitrakkeka, sheaz yukal liplot mimmenna qetzat lachluchit letok hammelach. Abal im lo nitlachlecha hachitta — apillu meqom maggaah en tzarik lehasir apillu betok happesach, shehare enah yekola liplot kelum:
